title: Station wagon woman reappears at Changi Airport

tellings.quote: I'm in the airport, Jangi airport. Very famous.

plain: Around 1990, a woman Peter Levenda links to an earlier sighting involving a station wagon turned up again, this time at Changi Airport in Singapore. Levenda, whom the episode bills as a CIA historian, tells Michels he was there himself: "I'm in the airport, Changi airport. Very famous." He tells it on an episode about the idea that unseen beings steer human timelines, which is what a reappearance like this would point to if it happened as he says.
